page.title: Call
page.purpose: A live voice conversation with an agent, holding the full viewport. The camera turns the device into an input the agent can read mid-sentence, which is the one thing a browser tab cannot do.

priorities.statement: Whether the agent is currently hearing you
What it has understood so far, as running text
That a photo can be handed to the conversation without leaving it
How to end the call, reachable without looking

states.description: The call is connected and speech is being transcribed.
The call is connecting; controls are present but inert.
Captured media is uploading into the turn.
Transcription degraded to a lower-quality engine; the surface says which.
Microphone or camera permission was refused; recovery is stated.
The call dropped; a reconnect action is offered.
The network is gone; the call is held and the state is stated.
The call ended and its transcript was written to the thread.
Nothing to show yet; the surface says so and offers the action that would fill it.
Content is from a cached read; its age is stated.

claims.statement: Whether the agent is currently hearing the caller is perceivable at a glance and never inferred from silence.
The end-call action is visible and reachable in every state of the call, including error states.
claims.rationale: A call you cannot hang up is the worst possible failure of this surface.

claims.statement: Call controls meet the minimum tap target size at every viewport.
The running transcript exposes a log role and announces politely without stealing focus from the controls.
A downgraded transcription engine is named rather than silently substituted.
claims.rationale: A silent fall back to a weaker engine is indistinguishable from the product being bad.

claims.statement: Capturing a photo keeps the call connected and returns to the same call surface.
A refused microphone or camera permission states the exact recovery step for this platform.
The listening animation degrades to a non-animated state indicator under reduced-motion.
The call surface is legible in both themes without a separate design.

regions.purpose: Running transcription of the live call.
